_meanings:
²1 To place, put, put or set down; {#Sirasi nidaDAno'Yjalipuwam#} <ls>Bh. 3. 123</ls>;
 <ls>R. 3. 50</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">62</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 52</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 13</ls>.
.²2 To confide, or entrust, commit to the care of; {#nidaDe vijayASaMsAM#}
 {#cApe sItAM ca lakzmaRe#} <ls>R. 12. 44</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 36</ls>.
.²3 To give, impart to, deposit with; {#dinAnte nihitaM tejaH savitreva#}

.²7 To determine, resolve.
.²8 To direct oneʼs labours, endeavour.
.²9 To appoint.
.²10 To remove, relinquish.
.²11 To lay up, treasure up.
.²12 To remember, keep or bear in mind.
.²13 To end, close.
